custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's output. In comic books, text is a structural component, not just decoration. If the text is gibberish, the object fails the 'comic book' definition significantly, regardless of how good the illustration looks. Also, check if the 'Spirit' comic's mask has symmetrical eye holes, as AI often distorts facial accessories.
